t_advice_summary_textbox.text: that each colours correlate to different basket colours which will give you more or less mushrooms based on the stage of the game. If one colour is giving less switch the gnome colour.

vb_textbox.text: I think it is best to pick a side, or a button- so either s or k. One side is usually more rewarding, I would then consistently stick with that one side/button until it returns you a score of 0, then when that side gives a score of 0 I would switch to the other side/ button. I found this more methodological than colours, and more profitable.v
